rules.description: base-ui's Accordion wires up aria-expanded and panel roles automatically — no manual aria props needed on Trigger/Content.
AccordionGroup's values prop must list every item's value, or expand-all/collapse-all won't include items you forgot to list.
Don't rely on color alone to carry status meaning — Badge always renders text content; if you go icon-only, add an aria-label.
Icons inside a badge are decorative (the text already conveys the meaning) — always add aria-hidden={true}.
Icon-only buttons (size starting with 'icon') always need an aria-label — there's no visible text for assistive tech to read.
Use the native disabled prop rather than styling a button to look disabled — it also blocks pointer and keyboard interaction.
When using buttonVariants on a Link or anchor, that element is not a real button — screen readers announce it as a link, which is correct since it navigates rather than performing an action.
Always add aria-hidden={true} to decorative icons.
Add aria-hidden={true} to the CardAction containing an avatar or icon when the card is inside a <Link> — prevents initials being read as link text.
Inline title links need hover:underline to be accessible on keyboard.
Add h-full on Card when it is inside a <Link> inside a grid — required for equal-height rows.
